---
title: "Types of Roots Flowchart"
format: html
---

```{=html}
<style>
/* Wronskian-style box */
.node-redesign {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border: 2px solid #444;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  min-width: 200px;
}

/* Different light colors for each case */
.case1 { background-color: #d4edda; } /* light green */
.case2 { background-color: #fff3cd; } /* light yellow */
.case3 { background-color: #f8d7da; } /* light pink */

.flowchart-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 60px;
  margin-top: 50px;
}
</style>

<div class="flowchart-container">
  <div id="discriminant" class="node-redesign">
    Calculate Discriminant:<br> \( D = b^2 - 4ac \)
  </div>

  <div id="case1" class="node-redesign case1">
    \( D > 0 \)<br>Real & Distinct Roots
  </div>

  <div id="case2" class="node-redesign case2">
    \( D = 0 \)<br>Real & Equal Roots
  </div>

  <div id="case3" class="node-redesign case3">
    \( D < 0 \)<br>Complex Roots
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  // Draw arrows
  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('discriminant'),
    document.getElementById('case1'),
    { color: '#28a745', path: 'straight', endPlug: 'arrow3' }
  );

  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('discriminant'),
    document.getElementById('case2'),
    { color: '#ffc107', path: 'straight', endPlug: 'arrow3' }
  );

  new LeaderLine(
    document.getElementById('discriminant'),
    document.getElementById('case3'),
    { color: '#dc3545', path: 'straight', endPlug: 'arrow3' }
  );
});
</script>
